create_WanModelSpecification: create a WanModelSpecification instance to load Wan text-to-video or image-to-video diffusion models
build_WanLatentEncodeProcessor: build a WanLatentEncodeProcessor to encode image or video tensors into VAE latents with mean and std
run_prepare_conditions: run prepare_conditions on WanModelSpecification to encode text captions with T5 tokenizer and encoder
run_prepare_latents: run prepare_latents on WanModelSpecification to encode video into normalized VAE latents for training
test_validation: test the validation method on WanModelSpecification to generate video samples from a pipeline
